mapper.select: select m.id, m.workspace_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.create_time, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.status as user_status from agent_workspace_member m left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' where m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} order by case m.role when 'admin' then 0 when 'developer' then 1 else 2 end, m.create_time asc

select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.status as user_status from sys_user u where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.user_id not in (select m.user_id from agent_workspace_member m where m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId})
and (u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by u.user_id asc limit 50
